boundary: This displayed product-channel determinant assumes conditional independence and known calibrated rates. More generally a known full-rank dependent joint channel also permits inversion; independence is not universally necessary. The coupling-robust near-corner support certificate needs neither this product formula nor a known joint channel. Nonzero determinant alone is not a stability or physical-validation guarantee.
